text:
maria gonzalez: Heads up — nightly per-route burn chart shot up ~48% at 02:20 UTC for eu-west-1 GPU fleet. Seen on finops/per-route dashboard: https://redwood.internal/finops/dash/per-route?range=24h :eyes:

samir patel: Is this the embed-route or gen-route spike?

maria gonzalez: Mostly embed-route (route_id: embed-v2). Per-model breakdown shows heavy p50/p95 token counts.

lee chen: Thanks — looking at cluster telemetry. eu-west-1 gpu-pool-7 had several node reboots around 02:15. Could be capacity fallback to on-demand causing cost blip.

anya kozlov: I see sudden reservation mismatch alerts — reserved capacity utilization dropped from 92% -> 61% at 02:17. Possibly health checks evicting instances.

ops-bot: ALERT: reservation-coverage-eu-west1 low: 61% (threshold 75%) — triggered at 2026-03-18T02:18:04Z

samir patel: Do we have the billing tail for that minute? quick query?

maria gonzalez: Posting a quick slice, david can you run minute-level delta?

David (finops): Ran a delta to bucket by minute — here's gist snippet: ```sql
SELECT minute, sum(cost) as cost
FROM billing
WHERE region='eu-west-1' AND service='compute'
GROUP BY minute
ORDER BY minute DESC
LIMIT 30;
``` early results show +$1.4k spike at 02:20.

kai ng: If nodes rebooted, traffic probably routed to reserved in other regions or on-demand in same region. Check routing policy fallbacks.

lee chen: Routing logs show 02:16-02:22 a lot of requests hit fallback model variant 'embed-v2-quant' on on-demand hosts.

anya kozlov: Could be autoscaler overreacting — saw a flurry of scale-down commands at 02:14 then scale-up at 02:18. Investigating scale policies.

maria gonzalez: Primary ask: need to reconcile finops per-route costs with reservation allocation for that minute + adjust alerting to include cluster-health signals.

samir patel: I can add a temporary dashboard panel correlating reservation-coverage, node-restarts, and per-route tokens. Will ping when up.

David (finops): Also recommend we run cost attribution query to split the spike across model and capacity type (reserved vs on-demand). I'll attach results in morning.

kai ng: Quick mitigation: set routing fallback to prefer dedicated pools with spare reserved capacity, rather than on-demand, for critical routes. Can we change policy for embed-route?

lee chen: We can add policy but need QA — will test in canary. Pushing change to routing config now.

ops-bot: DEPLOY: routing-config v2026.03.18.02 applied to canary (5%) by lee chen at 2026-03-18T02:35:00Z

maria gonzalez: Thanks. For follow-up: add a dashboard alert that triggers when per-route minute cost > $500 and reservation-coverage < 80% together.

anya kozlov: :+1: filing a ticket. I'll also look at instance termination logs to see why reserved instances became unavailable.

lee chen: Prelim: node restarts due to GPU driver OOM on 2 nodes — opened bug https://redwood.internal/bugs/INC-2026-432 (root cause feed).

David (finops): Putting a note in FinOps daily: provisional cost tag 'reservation-leak-2026-03-18' — will reconcile in weekly commit report.

samir patel: If we see repeats, we should consider bumping spare pool for eu-west-1 during night maintenance windows.

maria gonzalez: Looping @eng-sre for postmortem if needed. Thanks team.
